ns2:section.sectionText: Introduction to Psychotherapy, 3 hours. This course will introduce the student to the basic theoretical assumptions of each of the major psychotherapy models (e.g., psychodynamic, behavioral, family, couples). More specifically, change will be evaluated within each model and the efficacy of each approach will be reviewed. Broadly, the process of therapy will be discussed in each model (i.e., stages of therapy). Psychotherapy research ethics and clinical ethics will be discussed. Finally, recent developments and refinements in each of these major models will be presented with a particular focus on multicultural issues. First year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
